votes.motion: Endorse the ANR Plan for 871 and 915 Northfield Road.
votes.quote: p. bertram made motion to endorse the anr plan for 871 and 915 northfield road, t. cole seconded, all aye.

votes.motion: Send a letter to the Building Commissioner informing him of the prior nine-lot subdivision and requesting a determination whether the tenth lot triggers the 10% affordability threshold under the Bylaw.
votes.quote: p. bertram made motion that a letter be sent to the building commissioner informing him of the prior subdivision into nine lots

votes.motion: Approve the ANR Plan for 41 and 47 Reservoir Road.
votes.quote: t. cole made motion to approve the anr plan for 41 and 47 reservoir road, p. bertram seconded, all aye.

votes.motion: Approve the common drive for 41 and 47 Reservoir Road, with the stipulation that the culvert meet a minimum vehicle weight of 50,000 pounds and that it be so certified.
votes.quote: with the stipulation that the culvert meet a minimum vehicle weight of 50,000 pounds and that it be so certified, m. thompson seconded, all aye.
01.13.2020- p. bertram made motion to approve, t. cole seconded, all aye.
p. bertram made motion to adjourn, t. cole seconded, all aye.

decisions.decision: The Board asked A. Burney to send a letter to the Select Board requesting a meeting about the Brooks House, Library, and school buildings.

decisions.decision: The Board invites the APDC and the TCP Building Design Committee to the requested Select Board meeting.
decisions.quote: the board feels it would be beneficial for both the apdc and the tcp building design committee to be invited to that meeting.

decisions.decision: The Board's opinion is that a scenic road general bylaw, including fines, should be created.
decisions.quote: the board was of the opinion that a scenic road general bylaw, to include fines, should be created.

decisions.decision: Board consensus on the earth removal permit trigger: a threshold of 1,500 cubic yards.

decisions.decision: A. Burney will seek legal input on the earth removal bylaw.
decisions.quote: a. burney will seek legal input.

decisions.decision: Earth removal discussion to continue at the next Board meeting.
decisions.quote: discussion will continue at the next board meeting.

decisions.decision: Rules and Regulations Governing the Subdivision of Land tabled until after the Warrant closes in March.
decisions.quote: tabled until after warrant closes in march.

decisions.decision: Stormwater bylaw discussion tabled to February 10.
